The exmatriculation takes effect at the end of the semester in which it is issued, and in special cases at once. If you think the final fail is wrong, you can object to that decision in time and ask about hardship rules in your Prüfungsordnung. Contact the Studierendenkanzlei or an advisory service quickly.

part_time_study.title: Part-time study: needs an application and costs you BAföG
part_time_study.summary: A part-time enrolment usually needs an application with an important reason such as a job, caring for a child or relatives. Whether your degree can be studied part-time is set by your study regulations. Officially studying part-time means you have no claim to BAföG, and it can affect child benefit and the length of the student health insurance as well. Ask the BAföG office, the Familienkasse and your health insurer before you switch. Taking a holiday semester does not help with BAföG either.

fiktionsbescheinigung.title: Permit expired but extension applied: your old permit counts until the decision
fiktionsbescheinigung.summary: If you apply for an extension of your residence permit before it expires, the old permit is treated as still valid until the Ausländerbehörde decides (Fortgeltungsfiktion, § 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG). The Fiktionsbescheinigung is the paper that shows this. You may work with it only if your earlier permit allowed work, so a student who was limited before stays limited. The application has to be filed in time, before the permit ends. Keep the proof of your application and show it to your employer.
keywords: can i work while permit extension

training_cost_repayment.title: Training costs: repayment clauses are valid only under strict limits
training_cost_repayment.summary: An employer can ask you to repay training costs only if you explicitly agreed to it, the training gave you a real advantage on the job market, and you are not tied to the firm for an unreasonably long time. A clause that applies to every departure, no matter who caused it, is considered an unfair disadvantage and invalid. Too long a bonding period can make the whole clause void, and then you owe nothing. Read the clause before you sign and ask for advice from a union or Arbeitsrechtsberatung if you are asked to pay.

work_reference_right.title: Work reference: also working students, interns and minijobbers can ask for one
work_reference_right.summary: Everyone who works for an employer is entitled to a written reference when the job ends, and this right also covers working students, interns, minijobbers and part-timers. It is based on § 109 of the Gewerbeordnung and cannot be excluded. You have to ask for it, and a time limit in your contract or collective agreement for claims can also cover it, so do not wait. There is no general claim to an interim reference during the job, only if you have a good reason, for example a new boss or an application elsewhere.

online_return_costs.title: Returning online orders: who pays the return postage
online_return_costs.summary: For an online order you can usually withdraw within 14 days after you receive the goods. You have to pay the return postage only if the seller told you about it before the purchase, and if not the seller pays. The seller has to refund the price within 14 days after learning of your withdrawal, and may wait until the goods arrive back or you show proof you sent them. After the 14 days a return is only possible for defects. Keep the posting receipt.

streaming_price_increase.title: Streaming price rises: Netflix and Spotify need your consent
streaming_price_increase.summary: The Kammergericht Berlin held on 15 November 2023 that the price adjustment clauses of Netflix and Spotify are invalid, so they cannot just raise the subscription price on their own. A higher price needs your consent, which is why you get a message to confirm it. If you do not agree you can stay on the old price or cancel, and a regional court has ruled that earlier price rises without consent were invalid, so you might try to reclaim the extra money. Check your payment history and the notice before you click.

card_loss_liability.title: Lost or stolen card: you pay at most 50 euro until you report it
card_loss_liability.summary: If your bank or credit card is lost or stolen, you liable at most for 50 euro for payments made before you report the loss, as long as you were not grossly negligent. Gross negligence is for instance a PIN written on the card. After the report you are generally not liable. Block the card at once through the bank or the free number 116 116, and report it to the police. The bank has to refund payments you did not authorise. If it refuses, you can complain to the bank's ombudsman or to BaFin.

nachmieter_no_right.title: Moving out early: naming three replacement tenants does not end your lease
nachmieter_no_right.summary: A tenant can end an open-ended lease only with the legal notice period of three months (§ 573c BGB). The popular idea that proposing three Nachmieter lets you leave sooner is a myth. There is no general right to put forward a replacement tenant. Exceptions: your lease has a Nachmieterklausel, you agree an early release with the landlord, or you have a serious personal reason (the sources name illness or divorce) that makes the landlord accept a suitable replacement. Ask the landlord in writing before you promise anything to a new tenant.
keywords: find someone to take over my lease

mold_report_landlord.title: Mould in your flat: report it at once, in writing, and set a deadline
mold_report_landlord.summary: You must tell the landlord about mould without delay (§ 536c BGB). If you stay silent, you can become liable for damage that spreads. Do it in writing with a deadline to fix it, and keep photos and a ventilation log. Who pays depends on the cause: for structural defects the landlord is responsible, for wrong heating or airing the tenant is. If the landlord is idle and the mould is not your fault, rent reduction is possible under § 536 BGB. For a dispute about the cause, a tenants' association can help.

betriebskosten_catalog.title: Service charges: only listed running costs can be passed on, not admin or repairs
betriebskosten_catalog.summary: A landlord may pass on only the running costs listed in the Betriebskostenverordnung and agreed in your lease. Administration costs and repair or maintenance costs are not service charges and the landlord has to bear them. The BGH (VIII ZR 62/19, December 2019) held that a janitor's emergency-call flat fee is an administration cost and so cannot be charged to tenants. Check each line of your Nebenkostenabrechnung against the lease and ask to see the receipts.

dorm_contract.title: Student dorm: fixed-term contracts and weaker tenant protection are normal
dorm_contract.summary: Student dorms are not ordinary rental housing under the BGB. Several tenant-protection rules do not apply, for example the need for a legitimate interest for the landlord to terminate and the limit on fixed terms without a reason. Dorm contracts are therefore often limited to a maximum stay and simply end on the date in the contract without notice. Notice terms and deposit rules sit in the Studierendenwerk's rental conditions, so read them. Many allow early notice only to the end of a semester, so ask before you sign.

vacation_by_days.title: Part-time vacation is counted in working days, not hours
vacation_by_days.summary: The statutory minimum is 24 days on a six-day week, which means working days per week times four. Five days a week gives 20 days, three days gives 12. It does not matter whether you work two or eight hours on each of those days, so a student who works short shifts on five days still gets the full 20. Fewer days per week reduces your entitlement proportionally. In the first six months you build up the entitlement in twelfths. Your contract may give you more.
keywords: how many vacation days three days a week

aufhebungsvertrag.title: Termination agreement: do not sign under pressure, it can cost you unemployment benefit
aufhebungsvertrag.summary: An Aufhebungsvertrag must be in writing, signed by both sides (§ 623 BGB). By signing you give up protections such as notice periods, and the Agentur für Arbeit may impose a Sperrzeit of up to 12 weeks on unemployment benefit. Nobody can force you to sign. Ask for time to think (sources suggest at least 2-3 days) and for advice from a lawyer, union or works council. Without your signature the contract carries on unchanged.
keywords: do i have to sign termination

unpaid_wages_claim.title: Unpaid wages: you have three years, but contract deadlines can be much shorter
unpaid_wages_claim.summary: Wage claims normally expire three years after the end of the year in which they arose (§§ 195, 199 BGB). Many employment contracts add shorter Ausschlussfristen, often three to six months, in which you must claim in writing. Claims to the statutory minimum wage are not covered by such a clause (BAG 9 AZR 162/18). Remind the employer in writing, with a deadline, as soon as pay is missing. If it stays unpaid you can sue at the Arbeitsgericht or ask a union or a lawyer.

on_call_work.title: On-call work: 20 hours count if none are agreed, and four days notice is required
on_call_work.summary: Under § 12 TzBfG, if on-call work (Arbeit auf Abruf) is agreed without a set weekly time, 20 hours a week are deemed agreed. You only have to work if the employer tells you the shift at least four days ahead. A secondary source adds a minimum of three hours per call when no daily time is agreed. Ask for the hours in writing. Short notice shifts can be declined.
keywords: employer calls me in at short notice
must i come at short notice

ai_in_exams.title: Using ChatGPT or other AI in coursework: undeclared use can count as cheating
ai_in_exams.summary: Rules for AI tools are set by your Prüfungsordnung and the lecturer. Papers usually include an Eigenständigkeitserklärung in which you confirm you wrote the work yourself with the sources and aids you declared. Undeclared AI use is treated in many places as a Täuschungsversuch, and in a Bavarian court case a hand-in of an AI-written essay led to exclusion from an application. Check the rules for each module and declare whatever you use. Ask your lecturer if unsure.

internship_contract_proof.title: Internship paperwork: written terms, and a certificate when it ends
internship_contract_proof.summary: For a voluntary internship you are entitled to the essential contract terms in writing (Nachweisgesetz), and a written reference at the end. For a compulsory internship the employer should issue a Praktikumsbescheinigung which you need as proof for the university. No law demands a written internship contract, but it is advisable. A compulsory internship is generally unpaid and no minimum wage claim arises.

study_abroad_health.title: Semester abroad: German statutory insurance covers the EU only with the EHIC
study_abroad_health.summary: Within the EU, the EEA and Switzerland your statutory health insurance generally carries on during a semester abroad, and you use the European Health Insurance Card (EHIC). The EHIC is not a full travel insurance; for example it does not pay for a medically needed repatriation, and you may have to pay a co-payment. Outside the EU you typically need a private foreign health insurance. Erasmus partners may require proof. Ask your health insurer before you leave and keep paying your contributions.

sublet_furnished_notice.title: Sublet room: furnished rooms in the main tenant's flat can be ended on short notice
sublet_furnished_notice.summary: A sublease needs the landlord's permission first (§ 540 BGB), and a tenant can claim consent where there is a justified interest (§ 553 BGB). For an unfurnished room the normal notice is three months. If you live in the same flat and the room is furnished, the notice by the main tenant can be much shorter: it must arrive by the 15th of the month to end at the end of that month, and no reason is needed. A subtenant has a legally full tenancy against the main tenant. Put everything, including the deposit, in writing.
keywords: room in shared flat notice period

household_insurance_parents.title: Contents insurance: parents' policy may cover you in a WG or dorm, but only to a limit
household_insurance_parents.summary: Students in a first degree who keep their main home with their parents and live temporarily in a shared flat or dorm room may still be covered by the parents' contents insurance through its Außenversicherung. The covered sums are limited, and once you move into your first own flat you need your own policy. Cover depends on the insurer's terms, so ask in writing. Standard contents insurance protects a bike only against burglary from a locked room, not theft on the street, which needs an extra bike module.
keywords: insurance for my things in flat

overdraft_dispo.title: Overdraft: a Dispo is a loan, and tolerated overdraft costs more
overdraft_dispo.summary: The Dispo is an agreed overdraft limit and counts as a loan. Going beyond it is a tolerated overdraft (geduldete Überziehung, § 505 BGB), which normally carries a higher rate and gives you no right to be tolerated. If you are significantly overdrawn for more than a month the bank has to inform you about the amount, the rate and the costs; if it fails, it can claim only the repayment, not costs or interest. Banks can cut or cancel a Dispo at any time, so do not treat it as a savings buffer. Look at cheaper alternatives if you use it often.

non_compete.title: Non-compete after leaving: binding only in writing and with at least 50 percent compensation
non_compete.summary: A post-contract non-compete (nachvertragliches Wettbewerbsverbot) binds you only if it is agreed in writing and the employer promises a Karenzentschädigung of at least 50 percent of your last contractual pay (§ 74 Abs. 2 HGB). The ban may last at most two years and needs a legitimate business interest. Without the compensation promise the clause does not bind you. While you are employed you must not work for a competitor, but a side job that does not compete is generally fine. Have a lawyer or union look at any non-compete before you sign.

personnel_file_access.title: Your personnel file: you can read it, and ask what data the employer holds on you
personnel_file_access.summary: Under § 83 BetrVG you may inspect the personnel file kept about you and bring a member of the works council. The BAG ruled (9 AZR 791/14) that this does not include a right to bring a lawyer, at least where the employer allows you to make copies. Separately, you can request information on all personal data the employer processes on you under data-protection law; one source says it has to be answered within one month and no reason is needed. Put the request in writing and note the date.
keywords: what data does my employer have

studienkolleg_bavaria.title: Studienkolleg in Bavaria: needed if your school certificate is not enough alone
studienkolleg_bavaria.summary: In Bavaria the Studienkolleg (Munich for universities, Coburg for Hochschulen für angewandte Wissenschaften) prepares applicants whose foreign certificate only counts together with a passed Feststellungsprüfung. Admission needs such a certificate, an application for enrolment, and a passed entrance exam; there is no right to a place. The City of Munich says that with a permit that rests only on a university entrance qualification you must not work while applying for the Studienkolleg and during the Feststellungsprüfung. Ask the Studienkolleg and the Ausländerbehörde about your own case.

tax_study_costs.title: Study costs on your tax return: first degree is capped, second degree is not
tax_study_costs.summary: Costs of a first degree can be deducted only as Sonderausgaben up to 6,000 euro a year, and they give no Verlustvortrag. For a Zweitstudium, according to the sources usually also a Master, costs count as Werbungskosten without a cap, and an unused loss can be carried forward to later years. You need not file a return as a student, but it can pay off, and you may file for earlier years. Typical items named are semester fees, work equipment and travel. Consider a Lohnsteuerhilfeverein or tax adviser.

bafoeg_parents_refuse.title: Parents won't give information or pay: BAföG can advance the money
bafoeg_parents_refuse.summary: BAföG normally counts your parents' income. If they will not provide the information or pay the maintenance owed, you can apply for Vorausleistung (Formblatt 8, § 36 BAföG): the office pays without counting their income and tries to recover the money from them afterwards. Parent-independent BAföG exists only in specific situations, for example when the parents' whereabouts are unknown or after several years of work. Apply for it early and keep proof of your parents' refusal.

energy_contract_move.title: Moving flat: electricity and gas contracts have a special termination right
energy_contract_move.summary: When you move, electricity and gas contracts outside the basic supply can be ended with a special notice period of six weeks, and the notice may be given before the move. If the provider can supply the new address at the same terms, the contract carries on there. Moving to another flat in the same building counts as a move too. Check your contract for deviating terms, note the meter readings for both flats and tell the provider your new address.

health_insurance_switch.title: Switching statutory health insurer: two months' notice, or earlier if the extra premium rises
health_insurance_switch.summary: You can change your statutory insurer with notice of two months to the end of a month once you have been a member for 12 months. If your insurer raises or introduces an Zusatzbeitrag you have a special right to leave even before 12 months. The new insurer usually handles the cancellation, and it must not turn you down. Cancel yourself only if you move to private insurance or abroad. Check how your insurer announces a raise so that you do not miss the deadline.

dual_study_rights.title: Dual study: you are an employee with labour-law rights, but the rules depend on the model
dual_study_rights.summary: Students in a dual degree are covered by employment law, for example works council elections. Pay and holidays are set by the company contract or collective agreement, not by the university. In a study programme combined with an apprenticeship, the BBiG dismissal rules apply until the chamber exam and the Kündigungsschutzgesetz afterwards. In a practice-integrated model the BBiG generally does not apply to the study part, and pay should still be appropriate according to Bavarian model contracts. Read your Bildungsvertrag for the probation period and the repayment clauses.

rent_increase_response.title: Rent increase letter: you get the rest of the month plus two months to decide
rent_increase_response.summary: A rent increase to the local comparative rent must be justified, in Munich with the Mietspiegel. You have the rest of the month you received it plus two further months to check and agree; the higher rent is then due from the next first of the month. The rent must have been unchanged for twelve months before the increase. If you do not agree, the landlord may sue for consent within three further months. Check the letter, the date of receipt and the cap, and ask a tenants' association if in doubt.
keywords: do i have to agree rent increase

registration_missing_landlord_confirmati.title: Registering in Munich without the landlord's confirmation: you can hand it in later
registration_missing_landlord_confirmati.summary: You have to register within two weeks of moving in (the federal registration rule), and the landlord must confirm your move-in in writing within two weeks (Wohnungsgeberbestätigung). If you do not have it at your appointment, the Munich Kreisverwaltungsreferat lets you sign a declaration and send the confirmation in within two weeks. If the landlord refuses or does not answer, contact the Bürgerbüro. A late registration can lead to a fine.

employee_notice_period.title: Quitting a job: four weeks to the 15th or month end, two weeks in probation
employee_notice_period.summary: An employee can end a regular job with four weeks' notice to the 15th or the end of a calendar month (§ 622 Abs. 1 BGB). This notice stays the same however long you have worked there, and four weeks means exactly 28 days. In an agreed probation period, up to six months, the notice is two weeks to any day. The contract may not give the employee a longer notice than the employer. Notice must be in writing with your own signature; email or chat does not count. A contract or collective agreement can set different terms.

elterngeld_student.title: Student with a baby: Elterngeld minimum 300 euro, and you can take a leave semester
elterngeld_student.summary: Students without income get the minimum Elterngeld of 300 euro a month, and it is paid for 12 months, or 14 with partner months. You must live with the child in Germany and care for it yourself. Full-time students without a job have no Elternzeit in the strict sense, because that is for employees, but they can take a leave semester. At TUM such a leave for Mutterschutz or Elternzeit is possible for up to six semesters per child. If you receive BAföG, Elterngeld above the minimum is counted as income. Apply at the Elterngeldstelle of your state.

mobile_contract_notice.title: Phone and internet contracts: max 24 months, then monthly notice
mobile_contract_notice.summary: Since 1 December 2021 the minimum term of a mobile or internet contract may be at most 24 months (§ 56 Abs. 1 TKG). After that it cannot renew silently for a year: once it runs on, you can end it at any time with one month's notice (§ 56 Abs. 3 TKG). The provider must warn you before it renews. You also have a Kündigungsbutton on the provider's website. Contracts signed before 1 March 2022 may still have older terms for the first term. Cancelling online with the button gets an instant receipt.

interview_travel_costs.title: Job interview travel: the inviting employer pays unless it said otherwise in advance
interview_travel_costs.summary: If an employer invites you to an interview, it generally has to reimburse your necessary travel costs under § 670 BGB. It can exclude this or cap it, but only if it says so clearly together with the invitation. Ask before the interview and keep tickets. The claim comes from the invitation, whether or not you get the job. Other costs, such as pay for a day of leave you took, are normally not paid. If the employer refuses, your own costs can be deducted as Werbungskosten on your tax return.

interim_reference.title: Zwischenzeugnis: no automatic right, but you can ask with a good reason
interim_reference.summary: On leaving a job, every employee has a legal claim to a written reference (§ 109 GewO), simple or qualified. A Zwischenzeugnis during the job is different: there is no general legal claim, but you can ask for one if you have a legitimate interest, for example when your tasks change substantially, when you have a new boss, or before applying elsewhere. A reference must be clear and understandable, with no hidden messages, and you can ask for a correction. The employee has the choice between simple and qualified.

schufa_retention.title: Schufa: most negative entries stay three years, paid-off debts are marked as settled
schufa_retention.summary: A paid debt stays in the Schufa record but is marked as erledigt. The main storage period is three years for claims and for data on insolvency or debt relief proceedings after their end. A small unsettled claim under 2,000 euro that is paid promptly is not entered at all, according to one source. After the 2023 court cases the Schufa announced it would delete entries on a completed Restschuldbefreiung after six months. There is no clear nationwide statute for how long settled claims may be stored, so ask the Schufa for deletion in writing if an entry is wrong or unfair.

parcel_shipping_risk.title: Parcel lost or damaged: the online shop carries the shipping risk
parcel_shipping_risk.summary: If you buy as a private person from a business, the seller bears the risk until the goods are handed to you (§ 475 Abs. 2 BGB; § 447 does not apply). If the parcel is lost or arrives damaged, the shop must refund or deliver again, even with uninsured shipping, and it should not refer you to the carrier. Take photos of damaged packaging and contact the shop. The risk passes to you if you refuse to accept delivery. A private seller is different: according to one source, such a seller is not liable for loss in transit, so you only have a voluntary refund to hope for.

workplace_video_surveillance.title: Cameras at work: not without a reason, never in changing rooms or toilets
workplace_video_surveillance.summary: Filming employees without any reason is not allowed under § 26 BDSG. Cameras must be necessary and proportionate, and the works council has a say where there is one. Toilets, showers, changing rooms and sleeping rooms are off limits, and consent does not fix that. Secret filming is allowed only in narrow cases, such as concrete suspicion of a crime and when milder measures have not worked. You can ask your employer in writing whether and what data it stores about you, and complain to the data-protection authority.

mahnbescheid_objection.title: Mahnbescheid: you have two weeks to object, and it is a simple form
mahnbescheid_objection.summary: A Mahnbescheid is a payment demand from the court and not yet a judgment. You have two weeks to object (Widerspruch), using the form that comes with it, fully or in part. If you object, the creditor has to sue if it wants to go on. If the deadline passes, the objection is treated as an Einspruch against the Vollstreckungsbescheid, which again has a two-week deadline. If you think the claim is unjustified, object and get free debt counselling advice; do not just ignore it.

rest_breaks_rest_periods.title: Breaks and rest: 30 minutes after six hours, 11 hours rest between shifts
rest_breaks_rest_periods.summary: The Arbeitszeitgesetz requires fixed breaks: at least 30 minutes if you work more than six and up to nine hours, and 45 minutes if you work more than nine hours (§ 4 ArbZG). You may not work more than six hours in a row without a break. A break can be split into parts of at least 15 minutes each, and it is normally unpaid. After the working day you need an uninterrupted rest of at least eleven hours (§ 5 ArbZG). In hotels, restaurants and similar businesses this rest can be shortened under conditions. Teenagers have stricter rules.

door_to_door_withdrawal.title: Contract signed at the door or on the street: 14 days to withdraw
door_to_door_withdrawal.summary: A contract signed away from business premises, the classic Haustürgeschäft, can be withdrawn within 14 days without giving a reason. For goods the period starts when the goods arrive. If the seller did not tell you about the right, the period extends to 12 months and 14 days. There is generally no right if both sides complete the deal at once and you pay no more than 40 euro. Withdraw clearly and, where possible, provably, for example by registered letter. Contracts after phone sales are different. This also covers contracts signed after being approached on the street.

bike_traffic_fines.title: Cycling fines: red light 60 euro and one point, wrong path 20 euro, pavement 55 euro
bike_traffic_fines.summary: Cyclists can be fined too. According to the sources, running a red light costs 60 euro and one point in Flensburg, longer than one second 100 euro, and with an accident up to 180. Not using a signed bike path costs 20 euro, rising to 35 with an accident. Riding on the pavement as an adult costs at least 55 euro. A missing or defective light costs 20 to 35 euro. Amounts are taken from commercial fine-catalogue sites and police sheets, so check the current Bußgeldkatalog.

student_unemployment_benefit.title: Arbeitslosengeld I after studying: you need 12 months of insured work
student_unemployment_benefit.summary: Arbeitslosengeld I requires that you worked in insured employment for at least 12 months within the last 30 months before you register as unemployed (§ 142 SGB III). Werkstudent time usually does not count, because working students are normally exempt from unemployment insurance. While enrolled as a student you are generally presumed not to be available to the labour market, so ALG I is rarely possible. Register early, at the latest three months before a job ends. Talk to the Hochschulteam at the Arbeitsagentur.

photo_rights_social_media.title: Photos of you on social media: usually needs your consent, and you can ask for removal
photo_rights_social_media.summary: A picture of an identifiable person may in principle be published only with that person's consent (§ 22 KUG); there are limited exceptions in § 23 KUG. The right applies online as well as in print. If it is violated, you can claim removal, a cease-and-desist and damages. Ask the poster in writing to delete it, and report the content to the platform. A smile into the camera does not mean consent to every later use. Pictures by a photographer also carry that person's copyright.
keywords: tiktok video of me without consent

broker_fee_tenant.title: Estate agent fee for a rental flat: whoever orders the agent pays
broker_fee_tenant.summary: Since the Bestellerprinzip (2015), the person who commissions the estate agent pays the commission. For a rental flat that is normally the landlord. A tenant only pays if they themselves hired the agent to search for them. Splitting the fee between landlord and tenant is not allowed, and fees disguised as viewing, processing or contract charges are not allowed either. If an agent demands money you never commissioned, do not pay and ask a tenants' association.

warning_letter_employer.title: Warning letter (Abmahnung) at work: reply in writing or demand removal
warning_letter_employer.summary: There is no legal deadline for objecting to an Abmahnung. You can write a counter-statement (Gegendarstellung) and ask that it be added to your personnel file (§ 83 Abs. 2 BetrVG). If the warning is unjustified, you can demand its removal from the file, and if the employer refuses, sue at the Arbeitsgericht. An Abmahnung is normally a precondition for a dismissal for conduct, but not for very serious misconduct. Keep evidence such as emails.

student_health_contribution.title: Student health insurance contribution 2026: about 140 to 148 euro a month
student_health_contribution.summary: Compulsorily insured students pay a nationwide base rate of 10.22 percent calculated on the BAföG need rate of 855 euro, which is 87.38 euro, plus their insurer's own Zusatzbeitrag. Long-term care adds 30.78 euro for students under 23 or with a child and 35.91 euro for childless students from 23. In total that is roughly 140 to 148 euro a month depending on the insurer. Because the Zusatzbeitrag differs, comparing insurers can save money. These figures are 2026 values, so check the insurer's current sheet.

student_buergergeld_exclusion.title: Bürgergeld as a student: usually excluded if your degree is BAföG-eligible
student_buergergeld_exclusion.summary: Under § 7 Abs. 5 SGB II, students whose degree is in principle eligible for BAföG are generally excluded from Bürgergeld, whether or not they actually receive BAföG. There are exceptions in § 7 Abs. 6, and some one-off needs can still be covered. Courts have said that a part-time degree, which is not BAföG-eligible, does not trigger the exclusion. A leave semester does not automatically open a claim. Ask the Jobcenter or the Studierendenwerk's social counselling about your specific case.

bank_fee_increase_consent.title: Bank raises account fees: silence is not consent
bank_fee_increase_consent.summary: Since the BGH ruling of 27 April 2021, banks may not treat your silence as consent to higher fees or new charges. The bank must tell you about the change, but it only takes effect if you actively agree. If you never agreed, you may be able to reclaim fees, with claims generally becoming time-barred after three years at year end. You may refuse, but the bank may then terminate the account, and you can switch banks.

used_car_dealer_warranty.title: Used car from a dealer: warranty can be cut to one year, not removed
used_car_dealer_warranty.summary: A dealer selling a used car to a consumer cannot exclude statutory warranty entirely, but may shorten the limitation period from two years to one year if agreed. Within the first twelve months it is presumed that a defect already existed at handover, and the dealer must prove otherwise (§ 477 BGB, since 2022). A voluntary used-car guarantee runs in addition to your statutory rights, not instead of them. Sales between private people can usually exclude warranty.

sick_during_vacation.title: Getting sick during holiday: sick days do not count as vacation with a doctor's note
sick_during_vacation.summary: If you fall ill during vacation, days of incapacity for work that are proven by a medical certificate are not counted against your annual leave (§ 9 BUrlG). You must report the illness to your employer promptly and get a certificate, also when abroad. You cannot simply tack the lost days onto your holiday on your own: the employer decides when you get them, taking your wishes into account. Without a certificate there is no credit.

consumer_repair_replace_rights.title: Faulty goods: repair or replacement first, then refund or price cut
consumer_repair_replace_rights.summary: For a defective product you first claim Nacherfüllung, which means repair or replacement, and generally cannot demand a refund right away. The seller may refuse your chosen option if it would cost disproportionately much. Per the Verbraucherzentrale, you usually have to accept a repair at most twice before you can withdraw or reduce the price. Consumers no longer need to set the seller a deadline themselves. You can ask for an advance for transport costs, and for products bought after 31 July 2026 choosing repair extends the warranty once by one year.

tenant_special_termination_rent_increase.title: Rent increase or modernisation: you get a special right to terminate
tenant_special_termination_rent_increase.summary: If your landlord demands a rent increase to the local comparative rent or after modernisation, you can terminate the tenancy specially under § 561 BGB. You must give notice by the end of the second month after the increase request reaches you, and the tenancy then ends at the end of the following two months. If you terminate, the increase does not take effect. Agreeing to the increase first removes the option. A tenant also has a special right to leave after a modernisation announcement, except for trivial measures. Notice should be in writing.
keywords: landlord raised rent can i leave

parental_leave_notice.title: Parental leave (Elternzeit): ask in writing seven weeks ahead, protected from dismissal
parental_leave_notice.summary: Employees have a legal right to Elternzeit, including part-time and marginal workers, and the contract cannot exclude it. For the first three years of the child you must request it in writing at least seven weeks before it starts. The special protection against dismissal begins from the request, at the earliest eight weeks before the start, and lasts during the leave. Working part time during leave is possible, with a right to it under conditions such as a larger employer. Elterngeld is a separate application.

trial_subscription_one_withdrawal.title: Free trial that turns into a paid subscription: only one withdrawal right
trial_subscription_one_withdrawal.summary: Per an EuGH ruling reported by Legal Tribune Online in June 2026, a consumer can withdraw only once from a distance contract for a subscription that starts free and renews automatically into a paid one. When the trial turns into the paid phase, no new withdrawal right arises. So withdraw or cancel within the trial or the first 14 days, and set a reminder before it converts. Once the paid phase has begun, you can still use the normal cancellation rules in your contract.

labor_court_no_lawyer.title: Labour court: you can sue without a lawyer, and the Rechtsantragstelle helps for free
labor_court_no_lawyer.summary: In the first instance at the Arbeitsgericht there is no obligation to have a lawyer. Each court has a Rechtsantragstelle that records your claim for free, but it cannot advise you on the chances of success. A dismissal claim must reach the court within three weeks of receiving the written notice (§ 4 KSchG). In the first instance each side bears its own costs, whoever wins. A union representative can also act for you.

legal_aid_beratungshilfe.title: Cheap legal help: Beratungshilfe costs 15 euro, Prozesskostenhilfe covers court
legal_aid_beratungshilfe.summary: People with low income can get Beratungshilfe, a lawyer's advice outside court, by applying at the Amtsgericht. The court decision is free and the lawyer can ask for a one-off 15 euro. If a lawsuit is needed, you can apply for Prozesskostenhilfe at the court instead. If you already started with a lawyer before applying, the application must reach the court within four weeks of starting. The conditions are the same low-income test as for PKH and the request must not be frivolous.

applicant_data_deletion.title: Rejected job application: your data is generally deleted within about six months
applicant_data_deletion.summary: After a rejection, a company may keep your application documents only as long as needed, and data protection authorities accept up to about six months because of the AGG claim deadlines (two months to claim, then three months to sue). After that the data must be deleted under Art. 17 DSGVO unless a claim is pending. If you withdraw your application, the data must be deleted without delay. A longer talent pool needs your consent, which you can withdraw. You can also ask for access to your data.

cold_call_energy_contract.title: Energy contract pushed on you by phone: revoke in writing within 14 days
cold_call_energy_contract.summary: Advertising calls without your prior express consent are prohibited, but a contract can still come into existence if you confirm an offer, for example by replying to a confirmation SMS. If a power or gas contract was pushed on you, you can generally revoke it in writing within 14 days, and you should also revoke the authorisation to cancel your old supplier. Send the revocation in a provable way. Unwanted calls can be reported to the Bundesnetzagentur. Do not give meter numbers or bank details on the phone.

package_tour_defects.title: Package holiday defects: report them at once, then claim a price reduction
package_tour_defects.summary: On a package holiday your contract is with the tour operator. If promised services are missing or different, you must report the defect to the operator or the local tour guide without delay (§ 651o BGB) and give a reasonable time to fix it. Without that notice you can lose the price reduction and damages. Document it with photos and ask for written confirmation of the complaint. If the defect is not fixed, the price is reduced for the time it lasted. There is no fixed hour limit for the notice, but it must be prompt.

internet_speed_reduction.title: Internet slower than promised: you may reduce the price or terminate, number porting is free
internet_speed_reduction.summary: Under the Telekommunikationsgesetz, if your internet is regularly or clearly much slower than the contract says, you can reduce your payments or terminate extraordinarily. You must prove it, for fixed lines and mobile with the measurement of the Bundesnetzagentur. Taking your phone number to a new provider must be free, and the new provider leads the switch. Your service may not be cut for longer than one working day during a provider switch.

tax_class_six_second_job.title: Several side jobs: only one gets your tax class, the others use class 6
tax_class_six_second_job.summary: Single students are normally in tax class 1. If you have more than one job, the second and further jobs are taxed in class 6, where no allowances are applied. Tax withheld this way can often be reclaimed through a tax return if your annual income stays under the basic allowance. The basic allowance is 12,348 euro for 2026 according to student tax guides. A tax return can be filed voluntarily, with up to four years to do so.

reference_secret_code.title: Job reference: must be clear and true, secret codes are banned, claim lasts three years
reference_secret_code.summary: Under § 109 GewO every employee, including working students, interns and minijobbers, has a right to a written reference. A qualified reference must be clear and understandable and may not contain hidden signals or secret codes. The average grade is generally treated as satisfactory. Typical phrasing such as 'stets zu unserer vollsten Zufriedenheit' reads as the best grade. The claim usually expires after three years, but contract or collective deadlines can be much shorter, so ask early. If wording is wrong, ask in writing for a correction before going to court.

household_contents_underinsurance.title: Contents insurance: a sum insured below the real value means only partial payout
household_contents_underinsurance.summary: In contents (Hausrat) insurance the sum insured is often set at about 650 euro per square metre of living space. If it is set too low, you are underinsured and the insurer pays only part of a loss, for example half of a 1,200 euro laptop loss if the sum insured is half the real value. Many tariffs waive the underinsurance objection when you choose at least 650 euro per square metre. In a shared flat, subtenants' belongings are not automatically covered by the main tenant's policy, so check who is insured.

short_time_work_students.title: Short-time work (Kurzarbeit): minijobs and working-student jobs get no Kurzarbeitergeld
short_time_work_students.summary: Kurzarbeitergeld is paid only to employees who pay unemployment insurance. Minijobbers, interns and normally working students are therefore excluded. In addition, an employer can introduce short-time work only with a basis in an agreement, such as a works agreement, collective agreement or your individual consent. Without a valid basis you generally keep your full pay. You are not obliged to consent just because the employer asks, but refusing can have employment consequences, so get advice before signing.

employer_insolvency_pay.title: Employer insolvent: Insolvenzgeld covers up to three months of net pay, apply within two months
employer_insolvency_pay.summary: If your employer becomes insolvent and owes you pay, the Agentur für Arbeit pays Insolvenzgeld for up to the last three months before the insolvency event, equal to net pay. The application must be made within two months of the insolvency event. This is a strict deadline and the Agentur does not warn you automatically. Applying without all documents still keeps the deadline, and documents can follow. You usually need the insolvency certificate and your last payslips.

shift_schedule_notice.title: Shift plan changes: courts use a four-day notice period as the guideline
shift_schedule_notice.summary: Once a shift plan is published it normally binds both sides. The law has no general notice period for changing it, but courts mostly use the four days that § 12 TzBfG sets for work on call as a guideline. Without an emergency or a reasonable notice period you do not have to accept short-notice changes. The four-day rule applies by law only to on-call work, which must be agreed in the contract. Contracts or collective agreements may set other rules.

commuting_accident.title: Accident on the way to work counts as a work accident and is covered by statutory accident insurance
commuting_accident.summary: An accident on the direct way between home and your workplace is a Wegeunfall and counts as a work accident under § 8 SGB VII. Statutory accident insurance then pays treatment, and after a work or commuting accident you should see a Durchgangsarzt (D-Arzt). The way starts once you leave the building, so a fall inside the stairwell is generally not covered. Detours for private reasons or a long break can end the protection. Leisure accidents are not covered.
keywords: unfall auf dem weg zur arbeit

workplace_bullying.title: Bullying at work: you can complain, document it and in serious cases claim damages
workplace_bullying.summary: Employers must protect staff from bullying. You have a right to complain to the employer or the designated complaints office under § 13 AGG, with no form or deadline, and to the works council under §§ 84, 85 BetrVG where there is one. Keep a dated log and written evidence, because the burden of proof is on you in damages claims. In serious cases the employee may terminate without notice and claim damages (§ 628 Abs. 2 BGB). Get advice from a union, works council or counselling service before escalating.

student_self_employed.title: Freelancing as a student: register a business, small-business VAT rule applies up to 25,000 euro
student_self_employed.summary: Students can work self-employed. A trade must be registered with the Gewerbeamt, with a fee of roughly 15 to 65 euro depending on the municipality. The Kleinunternehmerregelung (§ 19 UStG) exempts you from VAT if turnover was at most 25,000 euro in the previous year and is expected to stay under 100,000 euro this year, and then you must not show VAT on invoices. Health insurance matters: family insurance has a monthly profit limit, about 565 euro according to ING, and above it you need your own student insurance.

p_account_garnishment.title: Account seized: convert to a P-Konto within a month, about 1,590 euro per month stays protected
p_account_garnishment.summary: If a creditor garnishes your account, the bank blocks it. Everyone has a right to convert a current account into a Pfändungsschutzkonto (P-Konto), even if it is overdrawn or already garnished. If you do it within a month of the garnishment order being served, the protection works retroactively. The bank has up to four business days to convert it. From 1 July 2026 the monthly basic protected amount is about 1,590 euro. Only one P-Konto per person is allowed, and a joint account must be split.

debt_collector_letter.title: Letter from a debt collector: check the claim, the registration and the three-year limitation
debt_collector_letter.summary: A debt collector can charge costs only for a justified claim where you are in default. You can check for free at rechtsdienstleistungsregister.de whether the firm is registered. Ordinary claims generally expire three years after the end of the year in which they arose, but you must actively invoke limitation, and a court order extends it to 30 years. Do not ignore the letter. Dispute unjustified claims in writing, and ask a Schuldnerberatung or Verbraucherzentrale if you cannot pay.

direct_debit_chargeback.title: Wrong direct debit: reverse it within 8 weeks, 13 months if you never authorised it
direct_debit_chargeback.summary: You can have a SEPA direct debit returned by your bank within eight weeks of the debit without giving a reason. If you never authorised it, you can claim a refund up to 13 months after the debit. For card payments a chargeback through your card issuer is often possible, usually within about eight weeks, in some cases longer. PayPal buyer protection must be requested within 180 days of payment and applies to goods and services, not friends-and-family payments. Act quickly and keep proof.

gift_voucher_validity.title: Gift vouchers: generally valid for three years, a too-short expiry may be invalid
gift_voucher_validity.summary: A voucher generally expires only through limitation of three years, counted from the end of the year in which it was issued (§§ 195, 199 BGB). Shorter expiry dates can be agreed, but according to the Verbraucherzentrale a period that is too short is invalid and the voucher then stays redeemable until limitation. A Munich regional court ruled against Amazon's one-year limit for gift vouchers. If the period expired validly before three years, you may have a claim for the money value according to the Verbraucherzentrale. If the issuer becomes insolvent, you can only register a claim.

event_ticket_refund.title: Cancelled or postponed event: you can claim the ticket price back from the organiser
event_ticket_refund.summary: If a concert or event is cancelled, the buyer generally has a claim to a refund of the ticket price, and the Verbraucherzentralen also see a right to a refund when the date is moved. Presale offices often handle the refund for the organiser, so ask there first, then the organiser. A court found that withholding presale fees after cancellation was not allowed in the case against Eventim. Tickets bought on resale platforms carry extra risk, so claim against the organiser or platform with proof of payment.

fake_shop_prepayment.title: Fake online shop: contact your bank at once, report it and secure evidence
fake_shop_prepayment.summary: Be suspicious when an online shop forces prepayment. If you paid a fake shop, act fast, because what you can recover depends on the payment method: debit, card and payment services allow reversals, while a bank transfer to a scammer is hard to retrieve. Contact your bank immediately, take screenshots of the shop and print all documents, and report the case to the police. The Verbraucherzentrale offers a free Fakeshop-Finder to check shop URLs and an emergency check.

graduate_job_search_visa.title: Job-search residence permit after graduating in Germany
graduate_job_search_visa.summary: After a successful degree in Germany you can apply for a residence permit to look for a job. It runs up to 18 months, is not extendable for that purpose, and allows any employment while you search.

chancenkarte_search.title: Chancenkarte (opportunity card) job search
chancenkarte_search.summary: The Such-Chancenkarte is first issued for at most one year. While searching you may work side jobs of up to 20 hours a week. Self-employment is not allowed with it.

foreign_licence_six_months.title: Foreign non-EU driving licence: six months after moving
foreign_licence_six_months.summary: A driving licence from a non-EU/EEA country is valid in Germany for six months after you take up residence. After that you must convert it, which usually needs a theory and practical test unless your country is on the exemption list. EU/EEA licences stay valid.

health_fund_special_termination.title: Special right to leave your health fund when the Zusatzbeitrag rises
health_fund_special_termination.summary: If your Krankenkasse raises or newly charges its Zusatzbeitrag, you may switch to another fund until the end of the month in which the increase first applies. The 12-month binding period does not apply, but the two-month notice period does. Since mid-2026 funds no longer have to inform you, so watch for increases yourself.

psychotherapy_appointment.title: Finding a psychotherapy appointment via 116117
psychotherapy_appointment.summary: The Terminservicestelle (116117, also online) arranges a first psychotherapeutic consultation (Sprechstunde) within about a week, with a wait of no more than four weeks. From there it can lead to acute treatment or further sessions. Say explicitly that you need a Sprechstunde.

copayment_exemption_limit.title: Copayment cap and exemption
copayment_exemption_limit.summary: Prescription copayment is 10 percent of the price, at least 5 and at most 10 euro. Yearly copayments are capped at 2 percent of gross income (1 percent for the chronically ill). Once you reach the cap, your Krankenkasse can issue an exemption. Under-18s are generally exempt.

dental_bonus_booklet.title: Dental crown costs: Festzuschuss and Bonusheft
dental_bonus_booklet.summary: Statutory insurance pays a fixed subsidy (Festzuschuss) of 60 percent of the standard care, more with a complete Bonusheft. Reports say the base share falls to 50 percent from 2027, but a Heil- und Kostenplan approved by the fund beforehand keeps the old rate. Low-income cases can get full cost cover (Härtefall).

ehic_abroad_cover.title: EHIC: health cover on trips abroad
ehic_abroad_cover.summary: The EHIC is printed on the back of your German health card. It gives access to medically necessary care in the EU/EEA, Switzerland and several other European states, on the host country's terms. It never covers a medical repatriation, so a private travel insurance is still useful.

severe_disability_card_study.title: Severe disability card and accommodations in study
severe_disability_card_study.summary: The Versorgungsamt issues a Schwerbehindertenausweis on request when the degree of disability is at least 50. Accommodations in studies (Nachteilsausgleich) generally depend on proof of an impairment, not on severe disability, so you can ask for them without the card.

study_without_abitur.title: Studying in Bavaria without Abitur
study_without_abitur.summary: Masters and equivalent advanced vocational qualifications give general access to a degree. Others with vocational training and work experience can get subject-bound access. The rules sit in the Bavarian qualification ordinance (QualV), so check the exact requirements with your university.

admission_hardship_application.title: Hardship application for restricted-admission degrees
admission_hardship_application.summary: Places in the hardship quota go to applicants for whom a rejection would be an exceptional hardship. If recognised, you are admitted ahead of all other applicants regardless of grades or waiting time. Many universities follow hochschulstart.de's practice.

exam_withdrawal_illness.title: Withdrawing from an exam because of illness
exam_withdrawal_illness.summary: Report your exam inability and submit a medical certificate (Attest) without delay, ideally the same day. A plain Arbeitsunfähigkeitsbescheinigung is not enough, and exam anxiety alone does not usually count as illness. A late withdrawal is generally refused.

online_exam_proctoring.title: Online exam proctoring and biometric surveillance
online_exam_proctoring.summary: In November 2025 the Thüringer Oberlandesgericht held that video surveillance of students in online exams is unlawful when biometric data is processed. Data protection authorities also criticise room scans and invasive proctoring software.

parent_support_student.title: Parental maintenance for students (Unterhalt)
parent_support_student.summary: Parents owe maintenance until a first vocational education ends. For a student living away from home the standard need in 2026 is 990 euro a month, of which up to 440 euro is for rent. Kindergeld is deducted.

eviction_deadline_protection.title: Eviction: Räumungsfrist and enforcement protection
eviction_deadline_protection.summary: A landlord needs a court judgment before any Zwangsräumung. You can ask the court for a Räumungsfrist until the end of the oral hearing; it should not exceed one year. In extreme hardship you can apply for Vollstreckungsschutz under § 765a ZPO, reportedly at least two weeks before the eviction date.

modernisation_notice_duty.title: Modernisation: three-month notice and hardship objection
modernisation_notice_duty.summary: A landlord must announce modernisation in text form at least three months before work starts. You must tolerate it if the notice is proper, but can raise a hardship objection in text form by the end of the month after you receive it. Up to 8 percent of the costs can be passed on as rent.

construction_noise_rent_cut.title: Rent reduction for construction noise
construction_noise_rent_cut.summary: Considerable noise from construction in your own building can be a defect that allows rent reduction. For a neighbouring building site, the BGH held it generally is no defect when the landlord has no claim against the builder. Report the noise to the landlord and keep a noise log.

search_result_delisting.title: Having personal search results removed from Google
search_result_delisting.summary: Under Art. 17 GDPR you can ask a search engine to delist results about you via its removal form. The operator balances your rights against public interest. Delisting is possible when the content is manifestly inaccurate.

cookie_reject_button.title: Cookie banners need a 'reject all' button
cookie_reject_button.summary: Non-essential cookies need your active consent under § 25 TDDDG. According to the VG Hannover, a site with an 'accept all' button must offer an equally visible 'reject all' button on the first level, otherwise consent is invalid.

data_breach_victim_rights.title: After a data breach: damages and next steps
data_breach_victim_rights.summary: The BGH has held that even a loss of control over personal data can be non-material damage justifying compensation under Art. 82 GDPR. Check what was leaked, change passwords, request a free Schufa self-disclosure once a year and report identity theft to the police.

doorbell_camera_rules.title: Video doorbells and neighbours' cameras
doorbell_camera_rules.summary: A video doorbell is only uncritical under the household exemption if the camera is activated by pressing the bell. Filming public streets and pavements is regularly unlawful. If a neighbour's camera films you, you can complain to the data protection authority or claim injunction in civil court.

image_quote_presentation.title: Using images in a uni presentation: image quotation
image_quote_presentation.summary: A quoted image must serve to explain your own content with a real engagement with it, merely decorative images do not count, and the source must be named. Images under a Creative Commons licence need attribution and the licence notice.

ai_image_copyright.title: Copyright in AI-generated images
ai_image_copyright.summary: German copyright needs a human creator, so purely AI-generated images generally have no copyright protection. The tool's terms of service can still restrict commercial use, and an output too similar to a protected work can infringe it.

imprint_duty_website.title: Impressum duty for websites and social media
imprint_duty_website.summary: A purely private website needs no Impressum, but running ads, affiliate links or promoting products makes it business-like under § 5 DDG. The same applies to social media accounts used for promotion. A missing Impressum risks Abmahnung and fines.

workplace_sexual_harassment.title: Sexual harassment at work: your AGG rights
workplace_sexual_harassment.summary: Sexual harassment is unlawful discrimination under § 3 AGG, even one incident can count. You may complain (§ 13), and if the employer takes no or obviously unsuitable measures you may stop work without losing pay (§ 14). Compensation and damages are possible (§ 15).

agg_two_month_deadline.title: Two-month deadline for discrimination claims
agg_two_month_deadline.summary: Compensation and damages claims under the AGG must be asserted against the employer in writing within two months. For a rejected application the clock starts when you learn of the discrimination (BAG 8 AZR 160/11). Missing it generally ends the claim.

homeoffice_no_entitlement.title: No general right to home office
homeoffice_no_entitlement.summary: There is no statutory right to work from home, and an employer cannot order it either. It can arise from the contract, a collective agreement or a works agreement. For formal Telearbeit the employer generally provides and pays the equipment under the ArbStättV.

working_time_recording.title: Employers must record working time
working_time_recording.summary: Since the Federal Labour Court decision of 13 Sept 2022 (1 ABR 22/21), employers must record start, end and duration of working time including overtime. Caveat: in a pay claim for overtime the employee still has to show the hours and that the employer ordered or accepted them.

whistleblower_protection.title: Whistleblower protection against retaliation
whistleblower_protection.summary: The HinSchG has applied since 2 July 2023. It protects people who report legal violations at work from retaliation such as dismissal. If a disadvantage follows a report, the employer has to prove it was not because of the report.

false_self_employment.title: Freelancer or really an employee? (Scheinselbständigkeit)
false_self_employment.summary: The German pension insurance judges the real working conditions, not the contract label. Being bound by instructions and integrated into the client's operation point to employment. Parties can ask the DRV for a status determination under § 7a SGB IV; back payment of contributions can reach four years.

trainer_volunteer_allowance_2026.title: Übungsleiter and Ehrenamt allowances 2026
trainer_volunteer_allowance_2026.summary: From 2026 up to 3,300 euro a year (trainer, tutor, carer for a non-profit) and 960 euro a year (other volunteer work) are tax-free. Students can use them, and they can be combined with a minijob if the activities are independent.

savings_allowance_freistellung.title: Savings allowance and Freistellungsauftrag
savings_allowance_freistellung.summary: Interest and dividends are tax-free up to 1,000 euro a year per person (2,000 for married couples) if you give your bank a Freistellungsauftrag. Low earners whose income stays below the basic allowance can get a Nichtveranlagungsbescheinigung instead (12,348 euro in 2026).

scholarship_and_bafoeg.title: Scholarship and BAföG together
scholarship_and_bafoeg.summary: The Deutschlandstipendium (300 euro a month) does not reduce BAföG. Several scholarships together only matter if they average more than 300 euro a month. Scholarships have to be reported to the BAföG office.

scholarship_tax_free.title: Is a scholarship taxable?
scholarship_tax_free.summary: Scholarships for scientific or artistic education are generally tax-free when paid directly by an institution, whether they cover living costs or education costs. The exemption only holds if the money is not a payment for work. Edge cases depend on the individual scholarship.

warranty_vs_guarantee.title: Gewährleistung vs. Garantie
warranty_vs_guarantee.summary: Statutory warranty (Gewährleistung) is a legal right against the seller: two years for new goods, one year can be agreed for used goods. In the first twelve months a defect is presumed to have existed at purchase. A Garantie is a voluntary extra from the maker or seller. You choose repair or replacement.

lost_luggage_claim.title: Lost, damaged or delayed flight luggage
lost_luggage_claim.summary: Report damage to checked baggage in writing to the airline within seven days, delay within 21 days of getting the bag back. Liability is capped at roughly 1,800 euro per passenger, not per bag (the figure moves with the exchange rate).

hotel_booking_no_withdrawal.title: No 14-day withdrawal for dated hotel bookings
hotel_booking_no_withdrawal.summary: Hotel bookings for a fixed date have no statutory right of withdrawal, even online. Cancelling is governed by the hotel's cancellation terms; a non-refundable rate usually gives no refund. Clauses can be challenged if hidden or rigid.

escooter_basics.title: E-scooter: licence, age and insurance
escooter_basics.summary: No driving licence is needed for an e-scooter, the minimum age is 14, and a liability insurance sticker is mandatory. Only e-scooters with an operating permit are legal.

escooter_alcohol.title: Alcohol limits on an e-scooter
escooter_alcohol.summary: The same limits as for cars apply: 0.5 to 1.09 per mille without signs of impairment is an administrative offence, 1.1 and above is a crime. Under 21 and during the probation period the limit is zero.

carsharing_fines_fee.title: Fines in carsharing and rental cars
carsharing_fines_fee.summary: Providers pass parking tickets and fines on to the driver and add a processing fee, roughly 5 to 20 euro depending on the provider. For a rental car the fine notice usually goes to the rental company, which identifies the driver from the contract.

legal_insurance_students.title: Legal expenses insurance for students
legal_insurance_students.summary: Cover usually starts after a waiting period of about three months, sometimes six in employment law; traffic cover often has none. Adult unmarried children in education are often co-insured under their parents' policy, so check the policy terms first.

blue_card_salary_2026.title: EU Blue Card salary thresholds 2026
blue_card_salary_2026.summary: For 2026 the regular Blue Card needs 50,700 euro gross a year (4,225 a month). Shortage occupations and recent graduates use the lower threshold of 45,934.20 euro, which needs Federal Employment Agency approval. The thresholds are updated every year.

settlement_permit_blue_card.title: Permanent residence for Blue Card holders
settlement_permit_blue_card.summary: Blue Card holders can get a Niederlassungserlaubnis after 27 months of qualified work and pension contributions, or after 21 months with German at B1 level. German at A1 is enough for the 27-month route.

settlement_permit_german_graduate.title: Permanent residence for skilled workers with a German degree
settlement_permit_german_graduate.summary: Skilled workers can apply for a Niederlassungserlaubnis under § 18c. Anyone who finished a German degree or vocational training needs only two years with a skilled-worker permit and 24 months of pension contributions. Otherwise three years and 36 months apply.

night_work_tax_free_rates.title: Tax-free night, Sunday and holiday surcharges
night_work_tax_free_rates.summary: Surcharges paid on top of base pay for work actually done are tax-free up to 25 percent for night work (20:00-06:00), 40 percent for 00:00-04:00 if the shift began before midnight, 50 percent on Sundays and 125 percent on public holidays (150 percent on 24, 25, 26 December and 1 May).

night_work_surcharge_right.title: Right to a night work surcharge or time off
night_work_surcharge_right.summary: Night workers are entitled to an appropriate surcharge or compensating time off under the Working Time Act. The tax-free rates in § 3b EStG are not an entitlement to that amount, and collective agreements can regulate it.

changing_clothes_paid.title: Is changing into work clothes paid time?
changing_clothes_paid.summary: If the employer requires work clothes to be put on at the workplace, changing is paid working time. Conspicuous uniforms that cannot reasonably be worn on the commute also count. A contract can in some cases exclude pay for changing time.

exam_inspection_right.title: Right to inspect your graded exam
exam_inspection_right.summary: Students can view their exam file: the questions, their own answers and the examiner's assessment. Notes are allowed, copies usually only with a legitimate interest, and many universities allow viewing only after grading is finished. Deadlines and details come from the exam regulations.

plagiarism_consequences.title: What happens if you plagiarise
plagiarism_consequences.summary: Plagiarism counts as an attempt to cheat. The exam is normally graded failed, serious cases can mean exclusion from retakes and a finally failed exam, and some states allow expulsion or fines. The exact rules depend on the exam regulations and state law.

ai_use_exam_cheating.title: Unauthorised AI use in exams
ai_use_exam_cheating.summary: The Kassel administrative court ruled on 25 Feb 2026 that using AI in an exam without permission can lead to a fail. In the cases there, a bachelor thesis and a master paper were marked failed and the students were permanently excluded from retakes. It depended on what the exam regulations said.

exmatriculation_consequences.title: What exmatriculation means
exmatriculation_consequences.summary: Leaving the register ends your student status, with effects on health insurance, BAföG and child benefit. Universities can exmatriculate you officially, for example for unpaid fees after the re-registration deadline.

sick_pay_werkstudent.title: Sick pay for working students
sick_pay_werkstudent.summary: Working students and minijobbers are entitled to up to six weeks of continued pay from the employer when sick. After that the health insurer's sick pay (Krankengeld) can follow.

sick_pay_waiting_krankengeld.title: Waiting period and Krankengeld amount
sick_pay_waiting_krankengeld.summary: In the first four weeks of a new job there is no employer sick pay. After six weeks the health insurer pays Krankengeld of 70 percent of gross pay, capped at 90 percent of net.

contraception_under_22.title: Contraception costs covered until 22
contraception_under_22.summary: Statutory insurers cover prescription contraceptives such as the pill or an IUD for people under 22 if a doctor writes a Kassenrezept. From 18 a legal co-payment applies. Private prescriptions are not reimbursed.

munich_debt_counselling.title: Free debt counselling in Munich
munich_debt_counselling.summary: The City of Munich runs a debt and insolvency counselling service with a hotline. It covers budget planning, talks with creditors and help applying for consumer insolvency, and it charges no fees.

youth_debt_counselling_munich.title: Debt advice for students under 25 in Munich
youth_debt_counselling_munich.summary: AWO Munich runs a youth debt counselling service for people aged 25 or younger who are in school, university, training or unemployed. It helps with unpaid bills, losing track of debts and trouble with creditors.

insolvency_discharge_three_years.title: Debt discharge after three years
insolvency_discharge_three_years.summary: Through consumer insolvency a person is freed from remaining debts after three years. An out-of-court settlement plan with creditors is tried first, and if creditors refuse the insolvency procedure follows.

newsletter_consent.title: Advertising emails need your consent
newsletter_consent.summary: Newsletters and advertising emails are generally allowed only with the recipient's consent. An exception for existing customers exists under § 7 Abs. 3 UWG. Double opt-in is the safest way for senders to prove consent, and you can object at any time.

renovation_clause_traps.title: Renovation clauses: fixed deadlines, quota and "always repaint on exit" clauses are usually void
renovation_clause_traps.summary: Many rental contracts push cosmetic repairs onto the tenant. Clauses with rigid deadline plans (for example every 3, 5 or 7 years regardless of condition), fixed cost quotas if you leave early, or a duty to hand the flat back freshly renovated no matter what are generally ineffective under BGH case law. Wording like "in der Regel" turns a deadline into a rebuttable presumption, which is treated differently. Where a clause is void, the landlord bears the cost of cosmetic repairs. Information only, not individual legal advice.

renovation_clause_craftsman_colour.title: Renovation duty: a contractor-only clause is void, and so is a colour rule during the tenancy
renovation_clause_craftsman_colour.summary: Even where a renovation duty exists, a pre-printed clause that forces you to hire a professional firm is void, and you may do the work yourself as long as the result is properly done. A rule that doors or ceilings may only be painted white during the tenancy is also void, while a colour requirement at move-out can be possible. Information only.

munich_conversion_notice_block.title: Munich: ten-year block on own-use notice after a flat is converted and sold
munich_conversion_notice_block.summary: If a rented flat is converted into a condominium and sold, the landlord cannot give notice for personal use during a block period. Federal law sets three years, but states may extend it to up to ten years in tight housing markets, and Bavaria did so for Munich. A notice given during the block period is void and does not become valid when the period ends. Check the conversion date and the flat's address against the Bavarian regulation. Information only.

pay_information_right.title: Pay transparency: asking what colleagues of the other sex earn
pay_information_right.summary: Under the Entgelttransparenzgesetz, employees in establishments with regularly more than 200 employees can ask for the criteria behind their pay and the median pay of a comparison group of the other sex doing the same or equal-value work. A comparison group of at least six people is required. The EU pay transparency directive is reported to lower the threshold to 100 from 7 June 2026, so check the current law. Information only.

headscarf_workplace.title: Headscarf at work: a neutrality ban is only allowed under strict conditions
headscarf_workplace.summary: The EU Court of Justice ruled on 15 July 2021 that a blanket ban on visible religious signs at work is indirect discrimination on grounds of religion, but it can be justified if the employer shows a real need for neutrality, for example because of customer expectations, and applies the policy consistently to all signs. Banning only the headscarf is still hard to justify. Information only.

bildungsurlaub_bavaria.title: Paid education leave: not in Bavaria, five days a year in most other states
bildungsurlaub_bavaria.summary: There is no federal law on Bildungsurlaub. 14 of 16 states give employees paid time off for training, usually five working days a year or ten over two years, but Bavaria and Saxony have no statutory entitlement. A union source says Saxony is due to get one from 2027. If you work in Bavaria you can still ask your employer. Rules differ by state, so check where you work.

disabled_dismissal_protection.title: Severe disability: dismissal needs the Integrationsamt's prior consent
disabled_dismissal_protection.summary: For severely disabled employees (and those with an equivalence status), the employer needs the prior consent of the Integrationsamt before giving notice, once the employment has lasted more than six months. Notice without that consent is void. The protection only applies if the status is proven or applied for in time, so tell your employer promptly after receiving notice. It does not rule out dismissal, only adds a hurdle. Information only.

business_transfer_objection.title: Business transfer: your job moves to the buyer, but you can object within one month
business_transfer_objection.summary: When a business or part of it is transferred, employment contracts pass to the new owner by law. Employees must be informed in text form about the date, reason, legal consequences and planned measures. You can object in writing within one month after receiving that information. If the information was missing or wrong, the objection period does not start. An objection means you stay with the old employer, which may then dismiss you. Information only.

meme_pastiche.title: Memes: not automatically legal, but parody and pastiche can cover them
meme_pastiche.summary: A meme built from someone else's image or film still is a use of a protected work. Since 7 June 2021 section 51a UrhG allows caricature, parody and pastiche of published works, and memes can in individual cases count as pastiche, but "memes are always allowed" is a common mistake. The classic quotation right in § 51 needs a genuine quotation purpose. Pictured people also have rights to their own image. Information only.

github_no_licence.title: Code on GitHub without a licence: you may not copy, change or share it
github_no_licence.summary: Software published without a licence is still protected by copyright. According to GitHub, without a licence the default copyright applies, so nobody may reproduce, distribute or make derivative works of it. For your own repositories, add a LICENSE file so others know what they may do. Information only.

mit_vs_gpl_licence.title: MIT vs GPL: permissive licence versus copyleft
mit_vs_gpl_licence.summary: The MIT licence is permissive: you may use and change the code, even in proprietary software, as long as you keep the original licence notice. The GPL has a copyleft effect: derived works must also be released under the GPL with open source code. Licences can be incompatible, so check before combining code. Information only.

orphan_pension_student.title: Orphan's pension: paid up to 27 while you study, and your earnings do not count
orphan_pension_student.summary: Orphan's pension from the statutory pension insurance is normally paid until 18. It can continue up to the 27th birthday during school, vocational training, a degree or a voluntary service, where training takes more than 20 hours a week. According to one counselling source, orphans may earn without limit without it reducing the pension. Check with the Deutsche Rentenversicherung for your case. Information only.

family_reunification_student.title: Bringing your spouse while you study: adult, A1 German, flat and income for the whole family
family_reunification_student.summary: Spouses can join students who hold a residence permit under section 16b AufenthG if they meet the requirements of section 30: both aged 18 or over, no sham or forced marriage, and basic German at A1 level. Your living costs must be secured for everyone moving, with enough living space and health insurance. A single shared-flat room usually does not count as enough space. Information only, check with your Ausländerbehörde.

invitation_guarantee_declaration.title: Inviting a visitor who needs a visa: the Verpflichtungserklärung makes you pay
invitation_guarantee_declaration.summary: To invite someone who needs a visa, you can sign a Verpflichtungserklärung under section 68 AufenthG at the Ausländerbehörde. It must be signed in person in writing, and you promise to cover the guest's costs, including departure costs, as set out in section 66. The authority checks your income, and in the sources checked recipients of Bürgergeld or housing benefit cannot invite guests this way. Think carefully, this is a real financial guarantee.

student_nursing_care_contribution.title: Student insurance: care contribution is on top of the health fee, and rises at 23 without children
student_nursing_care_contribution.summary: Compulsory insured students pay a health fee of 87.38 euro a month from 2026 (10.22 % of the BAföG rate) plus the fund's own Zusatzbeitrag. On top comes Pflegeversicherung: 3.6 % (about 30.78 euro) for students under 23 or with a child, and 4.2 % (about 35.91 euro) for childless students from 23. Check your insurer for the current figures.

education_credit_bildungskredit.title: Bildungskredit: 100, 200 or 300 euro a month for advanced students
education_credit_bildungskredit.summary: The federal Bildungskredit is a low-interest loan for students in advanced phases, in monthly rates of 100, 200 or 300 euro, up to 7,200 euro in total and with one advance of up to 3,600 euro possible. You apply at the Bundesverwaltungsamt and the KfW pays it out. Sources give the age limit as 35 or 36, and it can run alongside BAföG. Check current terms with the BVA.

payment_default_30_days.title: Overdue invoice: default after 30 days only if the consumer was told on the invoice
payment_default_30_days.summary: Under section 286(3) BGB you fall into default at the latest 30 days after the payment became due and you received an invoice. For consumers this only applies if the invoice expressly pointed out that consequence. Without that note, a reminder is needed. The 40 euro flat fee is only for businesses, and reminder fees for private people must be reasonable and cover actual costs. Information only.
